Available recipes:
    check                  # What CI checks on Linux: formatting, lints, tests and docs (CI also builds on the oldest supported Rust)
    default                # List the recipes
    fmt                    # Format the code
    lint                   # Check formatting and lints
    music                  # Download the full music set into ~/.local/share/koi-pond/music
    release *args          # Build the release archives for this machine into dist/
    run *args              # Run koi from source, with any arguments, such as `just run --theme moonlit-pond`
    serve port="8123"      # Build the web page and serve it at http://127.0.0.1:PORT
    shot out seconds *args # Screenshot koi in Ghostty on a private virtual display, such as `just shot /tmp/shot 8 --theme pixel`
    site                   # Build the web page into target/site
    smoke shots=""         # Check the built web page in headless Chrome, saving screenshots when given a folder
    test                   # Run the tests
    web-tools              # Install the web page's build tools: wasm-bindgen-cli at the version in Cargo.lock, and the wasm target
